title: skillx skills sources config
description: Configuration for subscribed skill sources, defaults, deduplication, and protected generated ids.

version.description: Config document version. The current supported version is 1.

deduplicate.description: Controls content-based deduplication across sources. Use a boolean for quick enable/disable, or an object for explicit settings.

oneOf.description: When true, identical skill content is deduplicated using the default content-hash strategy.

protectedIds.description: Directory ids or glob patterns that must never be generated into the managed skills directory.

sources.description: Ordered source list. Earlier sources win when the same target id or deduplicated content appears more than once.

strategy.description: Deduplication strategy. Only content-hash is currently supported.

defaultsConfig.description: Default values merged into every source unless overridden on that source.

branch.description: Default git branch used when a source does not provide one.

path.description: Default relative path inside the source repository that contains skills. Use . for the repository root.

mode.description: Default target planning mode. flat creates one generated directory per discovered skill, nested groups skills under the source id.

enabled.description: Whether sources are enabled by default.

preserveOnFailure.description: Whether previously generated output should be preserved when syncing a source fails.

cloneTimeoutMs.description: Default git clone timeout in milliseconds.

cloneMaxAttempts.description: Default number of retry attempts for failed git clones.

sourceConcurrency.description: Maximum number of enabled sources planned concurrently before generated directories are written.

includes.description: Default allowlist glob patterns applied to discovered skill paths. Empty means include everything.

excludes.description: Default denylist glob patterns applied after includes. Excludes take precedence.

sourceConfig.description: A single local or remote skill source.

id.description: Unique source id in lowercase kebab-case. It becomes part of generated directory ids in nested mode and must not match protectedIds.

type.description: Source type. remote clones a git repository; local reads from a repository-relative directory.

location.description: For remote sources, a git URL. For local sources, a repository-relative path.

branch.description: Git branch to read from. Falls back to defaults.branch when omitted.

path.description: Relative path inside the source that contains the subscribed skill directories.

mode.description: Target planning mode override for this source.

enabled.description: Whether this source participates in sync.

preserveOnFailure.description: Whether to keep this source's previous generated output when sync fails.

cloneTimeoutMs.description: Clone timeout override in milliseconds for this source.

cloneMaxAttempts.description: Clone retry count override for this source.

includes.description: Optional allowlist glob patterns for skill discovery under this source.

excludes.description: Optional denylist glob patterns for skill discovery under this source.

filterPatterns.description: Relative glob patterns using forward slashes. Dot and parent segments are not allowed unless the full value is .

filterPattern.description: A relative filter glob using forward slashes, for example vue-skills/** or .curated/**.

relativePathWithDot.description: A repository-relative path using forward slashes, or . for the source root.

relativePathNoDot.description: A repository-relative path using forward slashes. Dot and parent segments are not allowed.

gitUrl.description: A git URL accepted by the sync tooling, including https, http, ssh, git, file, or SCP-like git syntax.

protectedId.description: A protected generated directory id or glob pattern using lowercase kebab-case characters and optional * or ? wildcards.
